package.description: Find and delete duplicate files, music, photos, documents and much more!

en-US.description: Find and delete duplicate files, music, photos, documents and much more!
en-US.longDescription:
Duplicate Cleaner is a fantastic tool to help you organize the contents of your home hard drive or corporate network. You'd be surprised just how many redundant or duplicate files you could find forgotten in an obscure documents folder.
Duplicate Cleaner will deep scan for all types of files - photos, music, films, video, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, text files - you name it, if it appears twice on your computer then Duplicate Cleaner will find it. Once these files are found you are provided with helpful tools to enable you to select which copies to delete or move. These files can be deleted to the recycle bin or moved elsewhere.
en-US.name: Duplicate Cleaner Pro 5

zh-CN.description: 查找并删除重复文件、音乐、照片、文档等！
zh-CN.longDescription:
Duplicate Cleaner 是一款帮助你整理家庭硬盘或公司网络内容的神奇工具。你会惊讶地发现有多少多余或重复的文件被遗忘在不起眼的文档文件夹中。
Duplicate Cleaner 可以深度扫描所有类型的文件，包括照片、音乐、电影、视频、Word 文档、PowerPoint 演示文稿、文本文件，只要你能说出它的名字，只要它在你的电脑上出现过两次，Duplicate Cleaner 就能找到它。一旦找到这些文件，就会为你提供有用的工具，让你选择删除或移动哪些副本。这些文件可以删除到回收站或移动到其它地方。
zh-CN.name: Duplicate Cleaner Pro 5
